author: golem
body:
Live source/build proof received immediately. Module text/data/package and finite PREPARE/host-drain/RENDER/END/presentation design fit the existing interface; no new ABI is indicated. Keeping physics objects literal is useful evidence. Preserve current source/byte identities and send the final finite Pi helper/profile freeze before launch as planned.

One concrete readiness issue:2032/2048 is a module-only stack estimate and excludes firmware callbacks. The2048 field is admission metadata, not a separately isolated runtime stack; it is not proof of whole-call fit. Include the exact call-path/linked-library assumption behind2032, configured command-task stack and an estimate for the actual callbacks on each native entry. Identify any unknown/dynamic/recursive frame rather than summing unrelated frames or assuming the remaining16bytes is the physical task margin. PREPARE's ordinary command playback outside RUN usefully avoids a deep nested VDU-interpreter stack. During the bounded target, retain actual INFO17 low-water observations at useful entry/first-frame/exit checkpoints and a frozen failure disposition for inadequate margin. No automatic policy increase follows; rework/split if the combined evidence cannot justify the call.

The proposed360s overall/30s teardown reserve/60s raw-UART inactivity/first-failure stop is a useful finite plan; no target execution is released by this source receipt. Root has completed its own matched firmware builds, so no SDK compilation remains to compete on Pi. Oryx scheduling follows self-service; this is a technical stack/readiness review, not a scheduling grant. Return the concrete freeze and stack reconciliation or the smallest unresolved callback question promptly.
